# stripe_payment_method_domain (Resource)

A domain on which payment methods such as Apple Pay and Google Pay are offered. `terraform destroy` disables the domain, because Stripe cannot delete one; the domain stays in the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "stripe_payment_method_domain" "checkout" {
  domain_name = "pay.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_name` (String) The domain name that this payment method domain object represents. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this payment method domain is enabled. If the domain is not enabled, payment methods that require a payment method domain will not appear in Elements or Embedded Checkout.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `amazon_pay` (Attributes) Indicates the status of a specific payment method on a payment method domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--amazon_pay))
- `apple_pay` (Attributes) Indicates the status of a specific payment method on a payment method domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apple_pay))
- `created` (Number) Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
- `google_pay` (Attributes) Indicates the status of a specific payment method on a payment method domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--google_pay))
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the object.
- `klarna` (Attributes) Indicates the status of a specific payment method on a payment method domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--klarna))
- `link` (Attributes) Indicates the status of a specific payment method on a payment method domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--link))
- `livemode` (Boolean) If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
- `paypal` (Attributes) Indicates the status of a specific payment method on a payment method domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--paypal))

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import stripe_payment_method_domain.checkout pmd_123
```
